calls.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original abstract emblem master for fictional game flavor cartons, representative review only. Create ONE independent simple flat WHITE angel/heaven emblem on true transparent RGBA background. Design: a symmetrical pair of short gently upswept wings with THREE broad solid feather lobes per wing, joined by a small simple central dip; a separate thick horizontal oval halo floats just above the central gap. Wings plus halo only, no head, body, face or human character. Compact wide silhouette, overall width:height about 2:1, generous transparent margins. Solid opaque pure white ink, clean strong contours, halo thick enough to survive small shop-icon size. No typography or letters whatsoever, no AF, no crown, no real manufacturer/trademark, no religious cross, no extra stars, no ornament, no black outline, no grey/gold, no shading, glow, texture or 3D. This original emblem is not derived from any real brand's crown. Center the single emblem; no variants or layout sheet. Square transparent PNG.
calls.status: accepted after actual pixels inspected on dark QA backing; raw transparent rendering alone was misleading

calls.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: representative fictional game flavor carton revision, NOT game integration. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET existing black shallow carton. Input image 2 is the CANONICAL INSERT REFERENCE, the ONE original white abstract wings-and-halo emblem. Remove ALL the AF lettering from target image 1, restoring its dark printed stock there, and print the EXACT SAME complete emblem from image 2 in its place. Do not redraw or reinterpret its design: preserve the canonical thick oval halo, the single joined pair of wings, THREE broad feather lobes on each wing, central dip and proportions. White opaque flat ink only; no crown, manufacturer logo, letters, new text, human angel, gold, grey, glow or shadow on the emblem. Enforce the shared template: emblem overall width is 34% of the carton FRONT PANEL width, centered horizontally at front-panel u=0.50; overall emblem bounding-box center at v=0.17 measured from the front panel's top to bottom. Keep the canonical aspect ratio; use the exact same normalized mark size and position on all flavor boxes. Match the front surface perspective, not the full PNG canvas. Change ONLY the AF-to-emblem print region. Preserve the existing carton outline, top/right folds, shallow construction, material, camera, black color, exact flavor-colored brush panel and ingredient print, scale, location, framing, original square canvas and transparent margins. Do not shift or enlarge the box or move the flavor panel/ingredients. Do not add grass, vines, decorative leaves, extra ingredients, outside shadows, floor, hookah or HMD. True transparent RGBA background preserved. No letter A or F or other text anywhere on the result. Preserve the cool green brush and mint ingredient exactly as in image 1.
